title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Design and build scalable microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications using TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frameworks. Mentor junior engineers and drive architectural decisions across client engagements.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Architect multi-cloud solutions on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Define infrastructure-as-code strategies, optimize cost and performance, and lead migration initiatives for enterprise clients transitioning to the cloud.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Create intuitive, accessible, and visually compelling interfaces for enterprise applications. Own the end-to-end design process from user research and wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes and developer handoff.

title: Project Manager
description: Lead cross-functional teams through the full software delivery lifecycle. Manage stakeholder expectations, mitigate risks, and ensure on-time, within-budget delivery using Agile and Scrum methodologies.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. Elicit requirements, document processes, and collaborate with engineering teams to translate stakeholder goals into actionable specifications.

title: QA Engineer
description: Build and maintain automated test suites, perform manual regression testing, and champion quality across the development lifecycle. Drive test-driven development practices and continuous integration pipelines.
